title: Mortgage advisors and providers expats can contact
intro: These providers can help users move from research to a real mortgage conversation: independent mortgage advice, broker-style comparison, digital-first consultations, and bank/product checks. Treat this as a discovery list, not a ranking or recommendation.

items.reason: Expat-focused mortgage brokerage useful when users want English-language guidance on affordability, documents, lender comparison and the buying timeline.

Digital-first mortgage advice option; useful for users who prefer online consultations and structured document workflows.
Broker-style mortgage support for Dutch home buyers; useful for expats comparing English-language mortgage guidance and process support.
Traditional Dutch bank with English information and mortgage products; useful as a bank-side comparison alongside independent advice.
Large Dutch retail bank; useful for comparing bank-direct mortgage pages, documentation expectations and appointment options.
